name: Standing Band Trunk Rotation
definition: A strict standing elastic-resistance torso twist performed with shoulder-width feet, extended arms held horizontally, and a side-anchored band prestretched to twice its resting length. Vinstrup et al. directly measured left-to-right rotations while hips, legs, and feet remained in position and measured external-oblique, rectus-abdominis, and erector-spinae activity. Training the mirrored direction in a separate set is an explicit catalog symmetry adaptation, not a second studied condition. The source did not measure internal oblique or pelvic kinematics. Weight-shifting, pivoting, stepping, explosive, cable, seated-machine, chopping, and anti-rotation variants remain outside this family.

variantAxes.description: The side-anchored band begins at twice its resting length.
Both arms remain extended and horizontal.
The trunk rotates one direction and returns.
The source instructs the hips to remain in position without claiming measured zero motion.
Feet and legs remain in position without a weight shift or pivot.
The source-owned left-to-right set is mirrored for the other direction as a catalog programming adaptation.
One outward rotation and return counts once.
Elastic resistance does not constrain a guided path.

execution.startingPosition: For the source-owned set, stand with feet shoulder-width apart, the band anchored on the left starting side and stretched to twice its resting length, and both arms extended horizontally while the torso is rotated left.
execution.movement: Rotate the torso from left to right against increasing band resistance while keeping the hips, legs, and feet in position.
execution.endpoint: Complete the controlled rightward rotation without stepping, pivoting, or turning the pelvis.
execution.returnPhase: Return to the left-rotated starting position under control.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep the elbows extended and avoid leaning or bending the spine.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep both feet and legs in their starting positions throughout the repetition.
execution.sideOrDirection: Count each left-to-right rotation and return as one repetition. For balanced programming, mirror the setup and motion in a separate set; that mirrored direction is a catalog adaptation rather than a measured study condition.
disqualifyingCompensations: Pivoting the feet or driving through the hips changes the fixture.
Holding the trunk still changes the exercise to an anti-rotation hold.
Moving the hands diagonally changes the exercise to a chop.
